data.narrative:
Still Bright is a Seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Jon Vardner and Professors Alan C. West and Scott Banta. The target has raised $18.7M to date. The Climate & Energy sector comprises 9 known private peers and 1 public comparable (LNZA), though a narrow peer set at identical stage and valuation tier yields insufficient data for robust median benchmarking.

Only one valuation method proved applicable to Still Bright. Stage-Progression analysis uses the $18.7M raised as a proxy for current value and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding an implied valuation of $47M. This methodology rests on the assumption that capital deployment to date correlates with enterprise value and that the 2.5x step-up reflects normalized market behavior for climate-tech at this stage.

The triangulation range derived from available data spans $40M (low) to $54M (median $47M), anchored to a single method. The narrow applicability reflects genuine data constraints: while 9 climate-energy peers exist in the broader universe, none satisfy simultaneous filters for stage, valuation tier, and business model alignment. Key uncertainties include the durability of the 2.5x multiplier given macro funding conditions and the degree to which Still Bright's academic IP and technology differentiation command a premium or discount to sector norms. Additional revenue, burn rate, or customer traction data would materially sharpen the range.
